name: China AI Regulations
description: Comprehensive regulatory framework for artificial intelligence in China, including the Algorithmic Recommendation Management Provisions, Deep Synthesis Provisions, and Generative AI Measures

policies.requirement_ref: Algorithmic Recommendation Provisions Articles 4-6 - Algorithm transparency
policies.requirement_description: Providers of algorithmic recommendation services must inform users of the basic principles, purposes, and main operating mechanisms of the algorithm.

policies.requirement_ref: Deep Synthesis Provisions Article 7 - AI content labeling
policies.requirement_description: Content generated or edited using deep synthesis technology must be conspicuously labeled to avoid public confusion.

policies.requirement_ref: Generative AI Measures Article 9 - User rights and obligations
policies.requirement_description: Generative AI service providers must clearly inform users of the AI-generated nature of content and protect user rights including the right to opt out.

policies.requirement_ref: PIPL Articles 13-14 - Personal information processing compliance
policies.requirement_description: Processing of personal information must be based on the individual's consent or other lawful conditions, with clear and reasonable purpose.
